summary: Cypher stands at a public phone across the street from a burning paddy wagon that has collided with an oncoming car. Reporting the crash to Tank, he treats the 'goddamn car accident' as luck in his favour: 'Jesus, someone up there still likes me.' Tank says 'I got you,' and when Cypher demands 'Just get me outta here,' directs him to the nearest exit at Franklin and Erie, an old TV repair shop. Cypher hangs up, smiles at the sound of approaching fire trucks, and mutters 'An actor. Definitely.'

what_changes.before: Exposed on a public street beside a burning, crashed paddy wagon after an unplanned accident.
what_changes.after: Given a way out and set to leave, since Tank has located an exit.
what_changes.evidence: Just get me outta here. TANK (V.O.) Nearest exit is Franklin and Erie. An old TV repair shop.

what_changes.before: A crew member reporting an accident to his operator as though it were misfortune.
what_changes.after: Relieved the others are gone and openly pleased, framing the crash as luck and calling himself 'An actor. Definitely.'
what_changes.evidence: Boom. Jesus, someone up there still likes me.

event_hint.one_line: Cypher, having caused the crash that kills his crewmates, phones Tank to be pulled out of the Matrix.

uncertain: Whether Tank knows Cypher caused the accident or still believes it was chance.
Whether Cypher reaches the exit before anything stops him.
